MyPGRent

Rent, sorted for everyone under one roof.

MyPGRent keeps a PG or rental building in one place instead of spread across calls and chats. Landlords get a portfolio overview of occupancy, collections and pending dues. Residents get a digital pass, itemised dues and a simple way to report repairs.

Download on theApp StoreGet it onGoogle PlayVisit the MyPGRent website (opens in a new tab)
Category
Business
Platforms
iPhone and Android

What MyPGRent does

  • Landlord dashboard

    Occupancy, total collected and pending dues, with property, room, bed and tenant counts.

  • Rent cycles

    Automated billing, dues tracking, collection rates and expense logging.

  • Digital resident pass

    Room, bed, rent and emergency contacts in a shareable pass, with house rules and Wi-Fi details.

  • UPI payments

    Residents pay through their own UPI or bank app and submit a reference for the landlord to approve. Receipts stay in a ledger.

  • Properties, rooms and beds

    Multiple properties with floors, rooms and bed-level allocation and occupancy.

  • Maintenance tickets

    Complaints with photos and priority, tracked through each stage with landlord responses.
